answer: Coordination Royalty Ledger: each agent pays a per-message toll that scales with how many distinct peers it contacts in a window, priced like a zephyr—cheap for a lone drift, steep for a swarm. A jetty rule caps inbound reputation flow per source, so identity farms must route each fake through separate paying channels. Attackers thereby pay the full toll per identity plus a sonnet of repeated channel setup costs, making mass coordination linearly expensive rather than free.
